content:
I used to send RFQs that were puzzles.

I would send 8 files and 32 drawings to a group of vendors. I would ignore the links between them.

I watched my vendors spend afternoons matching BOM line 17 to drawing sheet 3.
I saw them spend hours chasing me for missing files.

I realized the vendor had become the project manager for my own RFQ.
They were doing the clerical work I failed to do.
This is not what they were paid for.

I saw that this work is invisible. It is not listed on the invoice.
It is quietly absorbed into the quote price.
Or it leads to a quote based on a guess.

A few years back, I sent a puzzle like this and got the "best" bid from the vendor who guessed best.

I learned that the alternative is the organized package.
The buyer manages. The vendor executes.

You might be sending a puzzle without knowing it. You can check if your vendor is doing your clerical work.

You did not send an RFQ.
You sent a puzzle.
The vendor who solved it fastest gets the job.
